title: Wong et al. 2024: complete source-claim coverage ledger

paper.title: A general and efficient representation of ancestral recombination graphs
paper.page_convention: Journal1-18 correspond to one-based PDF2-19. Zero-based PDF index equals journal page.

scope.inventory: Complete main text and Appendices A-I at claim-family level: mathematical/algorithmic assertions, examples, imported results, empirical claims and open questions.
scope.completion: Inventory complete, whole-paper mathematical and empirical completion NOT claimed.
scope.lane: Staged exact-source integration; public baseline is preserved; combined and hosted verification are separate.
scope.concurrent_work: 65 deterministic endpoints staged (24 MRCA, 31 interval, 10 normal form). Count-chain work remains a separate lane and is not counted here.

source_review.read: Main text and Appendices A-I inspected through primary PDF web text and full-text XML.
source_review.visual: Requested PDF screenshots returned image-reference text without visible images in this tool transport. Visual PDF review is not claimed; B/E/F-G formulas need a visible source-fidelity follow-up.

deterministic65_review.finding: Appendix E reconstruction from sample traces needs SampleSupported to recover all original edges; full AtLocus canonicalization is a different input.

rate_normalization_issue.status: Unproved source-fidelity concern, not declared erratum
rate_normalization_issue.candidate: Starting at 2, candidate occupation calculation: t_j=2^(j-1)*rho^(j-2)/j!, E[births]=exp(2*rho)-1, E[events]=2*exp(2*rho)-1.
rate_normalization_issue.conditions: Requires occupation identity, absorption/integrability and matching conventions. Separate lane inspects cited1997 source. No normalization silently changed.

documentation_repairs.repair: Distinguish support restriction from Fig 3 above-MRCA truncation.
Rename sample resolution to sample-support restriction in sample-ending path preservation claims.
Add current receipt context while preserving historical receipts.

claims.title: Finite interval gARG
claims.source_claim: Finite genome identifiers and samples; acyclic topology; child/parent records annotated by disjoint inherited intervals.
claims.existing_evidence: WongGARG.GARG, Interval, EdgeRecord; locus_acyclic and topology_iff_erased.
claims.remaining_target: No further gap for the permissive foundation. Keep source child-first tuples distinct from Lean parent-to-child edges.
claims.assumptions: Finite nodes; shared ordered coordinates. Unique local parents, nonempty annotations and canonical records are separately visible.
claims.completion_criterion: Definition/source correspondence and existing receipt remain explicit.

claims.title: Genome bounds, dates, owners and metadata
claims.source_claim: Persistent identifiers are not dates; edges may skip generations; genomes and organism owners differ.
claims.existing_evidence: GARG.exists_finite_topological_numbering and conditional GARG.locus_path_projects; older HistoryProjection adapter.
claims.remaining_target: Add bounded-genome presentation for formulas using L and a concrete cell/pedigree owner map satisfying compatibility; preserve node/sample identities.
claims.assumptions: Specify genome domain, time direction, ploidy and skipped generations; same-owner projection may be equality.
claims.completion_criterion: Checked concrete adapter with empirical biological assumptions identified.

claims.title: Multiple crossovers and gene conversion
claims.source_claim: Interval annotation can represent homologous recombination, including multiple crossovers and gene conversion.
claims.existing_evidence: Finite interval unions exist; checked event encoding is single crossover.
claims.remaining_target: Encode a finite partition with a selected parent per cell; prove routing equivalence; instantiate two-cut gene conversion and multiple crossovers.
claims.assumptions: Shared coordinate space, no structural variation, unique local parent on support.
claims.completion_criterion: Generic finite mosaic theorem and named examples; no universal biological validation.

claims.title: Classical event arity and parent ordering
claims.source_claim: Classical internal nodes encode merger or crossover events; cutoff alone leaves left/right parent identity ambiguous.
claims.existing_evidence: WongEventEncoding plus integrated WongEventDecoding: strict classical degree signatures, executable decodeKind, encoded degree/kind recovery, uniqueness of event-kind map and agreement of designated samples with sample kinds. Equal-parent crossover collision shows why distinct-parent normalization matters.
claims.remaining_target: The strict ClassicalShape is a supplied proof of degree validity, not a total executable validator for arbitrary graphs. Its signatures are sample(1,0), merger(1,2), recombination(2,1), terminal root(0,2). Broader root/sample exceptions and an explicit forgotten-left/right-order collision remain separate.
claims.assumptions: Fixed node IDs and positive span; proper interior cuts; distinct crossover parents. Strict shape excludes isolated samples, pass-through nodes, multiple crossovers and multifurcations; it is not imposed on all gARGs.
claims.completion_criterion: Integrated strict-shape encoding/decoding is checked. A general validator/exception extension or omitted-order witness requires its own exact statement; preserve current scope.

baseline_contract.remaining_target: Validate classical child arities, roots and samples; prove ordered distinct-parent constraints; exhibit loss of routing when parent order is omitted.
baseline_contract.completion_criterion: Checked validator and ambiguity witness; new event-lane work needs exact receipt integration.

claims.title: Lossless event encoding before simplification
claims.source_claim: First-stage conversion duplicates topology and labels edges by full span or complementary intervals; event information is recoverable.
claims.existing_evidence: Integrated WongEventDecoding proves normalized_same_local_iff, normalized_records_injective, encode_decode, decode_encode, Graph.parents_identified, Graph.graph_identified and Graph.encoded_canonical; left/right parents and cut are recovered.
claims.remaining_target: Mathematical first-stage inverse is closed on the explicit normalized encoding range. Executable recognition/parsing of arbitrary records, timestamps and external metadata are not supplied by this theorem; they must be preserved separately if added to the input model.
claims.assumptions: Fixed node type/IDs and known positive span; root/single-parent/crossover ParentSpec; distinct crossover parents and interior cuts. EncodedRecords includes an explicit range witness. decode uses Classical.choose; raw conversion precedes sample restriction.
claims.completion_criterion: The source's scoped lossless parent-specification conversion has an integrated receipt. Do not describe the classical range inverse as an executable universal event parser or claim recovery after simplification.

baseline_contract.existing_evidence: WongEventEncoding encoded_topology, encoded_atLocus, encoded_path_iff, encoded_parent_pointer and cutoff recovery.
baseline_contract.remaining_target: Define decoder on exact encoding image; prove inverse laws including event kind, parent order, cutoff and persistent node IDs.
baseline_contract.completion_criterion: decode(encode(event))=event and image-side extensional inverse with receipt.

claims.title: Sample-support restriction
claims.source_claim: Trace sample ancestry at each coordinate to identify supported inheritance.
claims.existing_evidence: AncestralRestriction locus_sample_path_iff, restriction_idempotent, restriction_nested, restriction_union_iff, indexed_recovery_iff; WongGARG.extracted_eq_local_iff_sampleSupported.
claims.remaining_target: Preserve the exact operation name. It keeps ancestors above local MRCAs, unlike M07.
claims.assumptions: Fixed-locus paths and retained sample/node catalog.
claims.completion_criterion: Keep exact support criterion and raw unsupported-edge counterexample.

claims.title: Fig.3 local-MRCA truncation
claims.source_claim: Fig.3 omits entirely coalesced material and the grand MRCA Q after all local genealogies coalesce below it.
claims.existing_evidence: WongMRCATruncation: 24 locally checked endpoints define reflexive common ancestry, remove edges into fully coalesced material, establish conditional unique MRCA existence, construct an actual finite interval GARG, and preserve sample/MRCA paths. Empty, singleton and sampled-root forest boundaries are explicit.
claims.remaining_target: The deterministic stopping semantics is closed. Literal Figure 3 data and stochastic sample-set/count transition semantics are not supplied; B01-B06 remain separate.
claims.assumptions: Finite acyclic gARG. MRCA existence requires nonempty samples, unique local parents and an existing common ancestor. The edge-removal construction itself is total; sample IDs and unused catalogue IDs remain.
claims.completion_criterion: Exact path-defined stopping rule, conditional MRCA existence and finite-output preservation are checked locally; aggregate and hosted verification are tracked at release level.

public_209_contract.existing_evidence: ExtractedAt and SampleSupported keep every ancestor of a sample; they do not implement this extra removal.
public_209_contract.remaining_target: Track descendant sample sets/counts, truncate above local all-sample MRCAs and prove exactly which retained ancestry/MRCA facts survive.
public_209_contract.assumptions: Unique local parent; connected sample genealogy for all-sample MRCA; explicit forest, zero-sample and one-sample cases.
public_209_contract.completion_criterion: Checked MRCA truncation and relevant example; no false preservation of paths from removed ancestors.

claims.title: Tables and incremental local-tree recovery
claims.source_claim: Succinct tree sequences use node/edge and site/mutation tables and efficiently recover consecutive local trees and differences.
claims.existing_evidence: Finite cell semantics are checked. WongMemoizedTracing now adds run_write_accounting, run_cost_bounds and memoized_cost_bounds: each nonempty cache entry is written once; checks/lookups are bounded by writes plus sample-list length.
claims.remaining_target: Define executable sorted tables and across-coordinate remove/insert updates, prove equivalence to direct extraction and analyze record scanning, functional-cache evaluation, actual array allocation and machine costs. The new per-coordinate abstract count theorem does not prove those costs.
claims.assumptions: For the count inequalities, even cycles or insufficient fuel are allowed; correctness additionally needs finite acyclic input and sufficient fuel. Functional cache updates and parent lookup are not assumed constant time. Sites/mutations remain a separately specified table extension.
claims.completion_criterion: Abstract per-coordinate counts are now checked. Sequential-across-genome update correctness and a concrete representation/runtime cost model remain required.

prior_publication_contract.existing_evidence: BreakpointCells and IntervalNormalization give noncomputable finite piecewise-constant semantics.
prior_publication_contract.remaining_target: Specify executable tables and update order; prove remove/insert updates match extraction and give a cost bound in nodes, records, intervals and updates.
prior_publication_contract.completion_criterion: Verified representation/update semantics and stated complexity; site/mutation extension declared separately.

claims.title: Unresolved event order in coarse topology
claims.source_claim: Polytomies and multiple-parent nodes aggregate unresolved coalescence/recombination order.
claims.existing_evidence: Fixed-node contraction permits aggregate outputs, without an event-refinement interpretation.
claims.remaining_target: Define valid refinements and observation fibres; construct different event orders with one coarse gARG.
claims.assumptions: Intermediate event identities are omitted; a refinement set is not a posterior probability.
claims.completion_criterion: Checked refinement examples and precise preserved/lost observations.

claims.title: Recombination detectability
claims.source_claim: Only some recombinations change topology and a smaller subset is detectable under specified mutation/rate models.
claims.existing_evidence: Graph collisions do not establish these probabilities or statistical detection bounds.
claims.remaining_target: Retrieve exact primary propositions; define probability model, observable sequences, event classes, rates and sample-size regime; prove the specific result.
claims.assumptions: Model-specific coalescent and mutation assumptions; no universal DNA/species conclusion.
claims.completion_criterion: Exact theorem and checked dependency, or explicit imported gap; no substitution of generic nonidentifiability.

claims.title: Tree-metric costs and overlooked shared identity
claims.source_claim: Some standard tree comparisons are quadratic or worse; treewise evaluation can miss cross-tree persistence.
claims.existing_evidence: No specific metric cost theorem or cross-tree-identity collision is registered.
claims.remaining_target: Choose the actual metric/algorithm and prove its cost; separately give equal local observations with different shared internal identities.
claims.assumptions: Do not quantify over all tree metrics; upper bound, lower bound and empirical runtime differ.
claims.completion_criterion: Specific cost theorem and formal observation example.

claims.title: Scalability, software use and standardization
claims.source_claim: Article reports tskit applications/efficiency and recommends shared software infrastructure.
claims.existing_evidence: Lean graph semantics do not certify software binaries or speedups.
claims.remaining_target: Record historical versions, cited benchmarks and interoperability examples; document recommendation as judgment.
claims.assumptions: Article-era software/data; full external implementation verification is a separate project.
claims.completion_criterion: Dated evidence or clearly unreplicated primary support; no formal-software-certification claim.

claims.title: Uncertainty and improved global benchmarks
claims.source_claim: Node-age/breakpoint uncertainty, downstream propagation, global metrics and realistic pedigree benchmarks are future work.
claims.existing_evidence: No solutions claimed.
claims.remaining_target: Keep explicit source open-question inventory and needed definitions; assess any new theorem independently.
claims.assumptions: Research questions are not established claims or automatically required new discoveries.
claims.completion_criterion: Faithful documented agenda with no invented completion claim.

claims.title: Big/Little common-observable law
claims.source_claim: Hudson and Griffiths formulations describe equivalent recombinant ancestry while their processes and graphs differ.
claims.existing_evidence: No coupling or probability-law model.
claims.remaining_target: Define both processes with matched parameters and prove equality in law of named sample ancestry/local-tree observables.
claims.assumptions: Same sample/genome/rate/clock conventions; explicit irrelevant-event projection and MRCA stopping.
claims.completion_criterion: Law equivalence of the chosen observation, not full event-graph distributions.

claims.title: NP-hard minimum recombination reconstruction
claims.source_claim: General parsimonious reconstruction is NP-hard, attributed to Wang et al. 2001.
claims.existing_evidence: No sequence-matrix model, complexity problem or reduction.
claims.remaining_target: Recover exact decision problem, mutation assumptions, input encoding and threshold; prove polynomial reduction with yes/no equivalence.
claims.assumptions: Finding a compatible history, finding lower bounds and certifying optimum are different tasks.
claims.completion_criterion: Exact primary theorem and reduction with size/runtime bounds; difficult mathematics remains in scope.

claims.title: Coalescent, ASG and inference history
claims.source_claim: Overview distinguishes processes, graph realizations, inference approximations and ASG nonuniform tree selection.
claims.existing_evidence: Bibliographic taxonomy only; no selection or ASG stochastic model.
claims.remaining_target: If claiming mathematical coverage of the ASG description, define random graph and tree-selection kernel. Historical mentions do not require proving every cited article.
claims.assumptions: No transfer of recombination graph proofs to mutation, selection or posterior laws.
claims.completion_criterion: Attribution documented and embedded imported model explicitly unformalized.

claims.title: Little-ARG lineage state
claims.source_claim: Finite distinct lineages carry disjoint (left,right,sample-count) segments; initially n full-genome segments of count 1.
claims.existing_evidence: Finite interval DAG alone is a different state space.
claims.remaining_target: Define ordered segment/sample-set state and retired coordinates; prove initialization, sample-partition and mass invariants.
claims.assumptions: Initially n>=2,m>=2 integer sites,rho>=0; equal-content lineages stay distinct; counts arise from disjoint sample sets.
claims.completion_criterion: Initialization and transition invariants justify sample-count sums <=n.

claims.title: Effective links and splitting
claims.source_claim: Link count is sum of max(right)-min(left)-1 over lineages, including trapped gaps; recombination rate rho*nu/(m-1).
claims.existing_evidence: Exact primary MathML UM1 and IM29 checked; no Lean transition theorem.
claims.remaining_target: Enumerate effective links and prove count formula; uniform split preserves exact ancestral segments and counts.
claims.assumptions: Discrete coordinates, nonempty lineages, proper cuts; eligible links are not only inside material segments.
claims.completion_criterion: Executable link enumeration and split, invariant proof, nonnegative/zero rates.

claims.title: Merge and retire fully-coalesced material
claims.source_claim: Unordered pairs merge at choose(k,2); overlapping counts add, material of count n is retired.
claims.existing_evidence: Primary MathML IM31 and IM34-IM36 reviewed. WongMRCATruncation now verifies the deterministic path-defined fully-coalesced retirement condition on a supplied finite graph. It does not implement stochastic lineage overlay, count addition or a sample-partition invariant.
claims.remaining_target: Prove canonical overlay, additive overlap, preserved nonoverlap and correct retirement/empty-lineage deletion.
claims.assumptions: Disjoint sample-set invariant, distinct pair and half-open endpoints; subset coalescence does not retire material.
claims.completion_criterion: Valid transitions preserve sample genealogy and record the local MRCA correctly.

public_209_contract.existing_evidence: MathML IM31 and IM34-IM36 verified; no transition semantics.
public_209_contract.remaining_target: Prove canonical overlay, additive overlap, preserved nonoverlap and correct retirement/empty-lineage deletion.
public_209_contract.assumptions: Disjoint sample-set invariant, distinct pair and half-open endpoints; subset coalescence does not retire material.
public_209_contract.completion_criterion: Valid transitions preserve sample genealogy and record the local MRCA correctly.

claims.title: Big-ARG generator and event recording
claims.source_claim: At k lineages rates are choose(k,2) mergers and k*rho recombinations; stop at 1.
claims.existing_evidence: MathML IM38/IM39 verified; event encoding is not a probability kernel.
claims.remaining_target: Construct continuous-time jump process or exponential-holding sampler and prove finite event-graph prefix validity.
claims.assumptions: Finite rho and n; absorbing 1; explicit discrete/continuous breakpoint distribution and time units.
claims.completion_criterion: Well-defined kernel and valid event records.

claims.title: Big nonexplosion and almost-sure absorption
claims.source_claim: The source asserts finite-time arrival at the grand MRCA, citing quadratic merger versus linear branching.
claims.existing_evidence: No stochastic termination theorem; finite traversal bounds are unrelated.
claims.remaining_target: Prove nonexplosion and almost-sure finite hitting time of 1; establish integrability needed for expectations.
claims.assumptions: lambda_k=k*rho, mu_k=k(k-1)/2; finite initial k/rho; absorbing 1.
claims.completion_criterion: Probability theorem, not deterministic termination of every random execution.

claims.title: Little-ARG absorption
claims.source_claim: Every coordinate eventually coalesces and active lineages disappear.
claims.existing_evidence: No stochastic proof; recombination increases lineage count.
claims.remaining_target: Prove nonexplosion and almost-sure retirement of all coordinates, directly or via a justified coupling.
claims.assumptions: Initial finite discrete genome/sample/rate; continuum extension separate.
claims.completion_criterion: Almost-sure theorem with explicit regime, not a decreasing-lineage ranking argument.

claims.title: Big exponential event growth
claims.source_claim: The article writes O(exp(rho)) events to grand MRCA and cites Griffiths-Marjoram 1997.
claims.existing_evidence: Exact MathML IM41; no formal cost variable or bound.
claims.remaining_target: Resolve expectation, event type, asymptotic regime and rate convention. Literal rates suggest a factor-of-two exponential mismatch; prove the correctly matched result.
claims.assumptions: Fix n>=2, random cost, absorption/integrability and rho normalization; time rescaling leaves birth/death ratio unchanged.
claims.completion_criterion: Matched primary result and proved bound; no silent replacement of exp(rho) with exp(2*rho).

claims.title: Little quadratic event growth
claims.source_claim: The article writes O(rho^2) simulation events, citing Hein 2004 and Baumdicker2022.
claims.existing_evidence: Exact MathML IM42; no cost proof.
claims.remaining_target: Find precise bound, expectation and discrete/continuous regime; state dependence on n,m,rho and event types; prove it.
claims.assumptions: Matched normalization and constants; runtime also needs controlled per-event cost.
claims.completion_criterion: Explicit theorem in declared regime or unresolved imported gap.

claims.title: Timed lineage/link counts and likelihood
claims.source_claim: Rates require k(t),nu(t); a gARG may leave recombination time and grouping ambiguous.
claims.existing_evidence: WongTimedHistory proves a concrete family of valid timed seven-node event graphs: omission of the recombination node gives exactly the same observed six-node interval gARG and retained dates, while event times 2 and 4 produce actual crossing-edge lineage counts 4 and 3 at time 3. Exact time/count decoders are ruled out on this family.
claims.remaining_target: The deterministic timing/lineage collision is closed for this specified observation. Define the full stochastic model, piecewise effective-link counts, rate/likelihood function and data laws before claiming likelihood results; the witness does not prove likelihood equality or general statistical impossibility.
claims.assumptions: Backward natural-number dates, strict chronological edges, strict binary event arities, explicit local contraction and retained-ID embedding. Count interpretation is before terminal-root time 10; no continuing post-root absorbing lineage is asserted.
claims.completion_criterion: The explicit no-decoder witness is checked. Source likelihood and continuous-time process claims remain separate B01-B10 obligations.

prior_publication_contract.existing_evidence: Generic recovery theorem and cutoff collision lack timed likelihood histories.
prior_publication_contract.remaining_target: Define timed histories and observation, count trajectories and likelihood; exhibit equal gARGs with different times/counts.
prior_publication_contract.completion_criterion: Typed collision/nonrecoverability and correct likelihood formulas.

claims.title: Extrinsic paired-parent timing convention
claims.source_claim: Paired parental genomes at recombination time and grouping conventions can restore lineage splitting and trapped links.
claims.existing_evidence: No timed grouping decoder.
claims.remaining_target: Define enriched timed nodes and grouping; prove recovery of event partition and k(t),nu(t), including gaps.
claims.assumptions: Basic coalescent, paired identities/times, ordered routing; not arbitrary gARG topology.
claims.completion_criterion: Sufficient-data inverse plus failure when the convention is omitted.

claims.title: Matrix moves and along-genome SPR
claims.source_claim: Parsimony methods use sequence row/column moves or successive tree rearrangements.
claims.existing_evidence: No sequence-state semantics or reconstruction algorithms.
claims.remaining_target: Define named mutation/coalescence/recombination moves and prove compatibility of constructed ARGs; formalize event-to-SPR relation including invisible events.
claims.assumptions: Mutation model, finite matrix encoding, rooting and moves explicit; heuristics do not certify optima.
claims.completion_criterion: Sound move semantics for claimed algorithm families; hardness is A02, software reproduction separate.

claims.title: Monte Carlo, approximations and consensus
claims.source_claim: Methods average over ARGs or approximate models; consensus uses breakpoint frequency threshold k plus extra filters and local consensus trees.
claims.existing_evidence: No target posterior, invariant sampler law or exact consensus rule.
claims.remaining_target: Obtain precise primary target/approximation and filtering/consensus rules for any claimed formal coverage; prove a clearly named property.
claims.assumptions: A sampled cloud is not all compatible histories; graph validity does not prove sampler correctness.
claims.completion_criterion: Specified algorithm/property or explicit unformalized imported description; not an implied proof of every listed package.

claims.title: Historical inference scalability
claims.source_claim: Article gives practical dataset-size limits and an article-era scalability ranking.
claims.existing_evidence: No independent benchmark evidence in Lean receipts.
claims.remaining_target: Record historical versions, hardware, sample/sequence sizes and cited experiments; reproduce if asserting independent confirmation.
claims.assumptions: Historical publication context; runtime and accuracy are empirical.
claims.completion_criterion: Dated evidence with limitations, not a current ranking.

claims.title: Cell-lineage tagging and owner projection
claims.source_claim: Genomes can tag the same event above or below it; one child-event node and paired parental-genome nodes are different encodings.
claims.existing_evidence: HistoryProjection proves conditional owner path projection; no actual cellular instance.
claims.remaining_target: Construct finite diploid cell lineage/pedigree; prove both tag projections and owner compatibility preserve specified ancestry.
claims.assumptions: Explicit mitosis/meiosis model, ploidy, timing and within-organism equality; many-to-one owners allowed.
claims.completion_criterion: Source-grounded example with commuting ancestry maps; no automatic Alexander infinitary transfer.

claims.title: Mutation information resolving cellular bifurcations
claims.source_claim: Schematic polytomies reflect successive bifurcations; informative mutations can in principle distinguish them.
claims.existing_evidence: No mutation observation or reconstruction model.
claims.remaining_target: Define binary cell lineage and explicit sufficient mutation observations; prove distinction of the relevant branch order and give failures with inadequate data.
claims.assumptions: Semiconservative duplication is an empirical premise; mutation recurrence/errors/sampling must be specified.
claims.completion_criterion: Conditional sufficient-data result with biological premise attributed; not undefined 'enough mutations'.

claims.title: Executable sample-to-root extraction
claims.source_claim: Initialize parent array empty; trace each sample rootward at a coordinate until a root or previously traversed parent entry.
claims.existing_evidence: WongSampleTracing and WongRecordTracing verify executable actual-record extraction. WongMemoizedTracing additionally proves cache closure, visited-entry early stopping, completeness, equality to the reference extractor, actual-gARG extraction with fuel equal to node cardinality, and records_to_memoized_sample_array. Persistent node IDs and unary ancestors are retained.
claims.remaining_target: The sample-rootward algorithm and abstract write/check/lookup counts are checked. Canonical finite interval semantics is now supplied by E03/G06; executable whole-exporter, machine-array storage, concrete scanning/runtime costs and external tskit conformance remain open. MRCA truncation is a separate operation.
claims.assumptions: Finite acyclic gARG, unique local parent, decidable node equality/ordered-coordinate tests, exact record/sample membership enumerations; duplicate and reordered lists are permitted. A root and an unvisited node both have none, so roots may be looked up repeatedly; this is included in the counts.
claims.completion_criterion: Faithful memoized extraction from actual records equals ExtractedAt, using node-count fuel, with standard-axiom verification. Count bounds are abstract operation counts, not constant-time machine operations.

baseline_contract.existing_evidence: GARG.local_parent_representation, ExtractedAt and WongLocalArity.backward_parent_array_bound; current definitions are noncomputable.
baseline_contract.remaining_target: Implement finite edge lookup and array updates; prove termination with sufficient fuel, correctness against ExtractedAt, sample-order independence and idempotence.
baseline_contract.completion_criterion: Executable result equals specification on every admissible input with fuel/cost bound; this is not M07 MRCA truncation.

prior_publication_contract.existing_evidence: Integrated WongSampleTracing supplies executable fuel-bounded traversal and exact sample-array semantics; WongRecordTracing scans actual finite interval-record lists and proves records_to_sample_array. Fuel equal to the node cardinality suffices, preserving unary ancestors and sparse entries.
prior_publication_contract.remaining_target: The reference implementation repeats shared paths rather than performing the paper's visited-entry early stop. Memoized traversal is provisional, not credited here. A formal operational cost model, explicit order/idempotence API results and finite-array serialization remain additional targets.
prior_publication_contract.completion_criterion: Actual records-to-sample-parent relation correctness is integrated. Complete the faithful memoized operational contract and any claimed cost/serialization result separately; no MRCA-truncation claim.

public_209_contract.existing_evidence: WongSampleTracing and WongRecordTracing verify executable actual-record extraction. WongMemoizedTracing additionally proves cache closure, visited-entry early stopping, completeness, equality to the reference extractor, actual-gARG extraction with fuel equal to node cardinality, and records_to_memoized_sample_array. Persistent node IDs and unary ancestors are retained.
public_209_contract.remaining_target: The stated sample-rootward algorithm and abstract write/check/lookup counts are checked. Finite canonical interval serialization remains E03/G06; machine-array storage, concrete record-comparison/runtime costs and external tskit conformance remain M08/G07. No local-MRCA truncation is implied.
public_209_contract.assumptions: Finite acyclic gARG, unique local parent, decidable node equality/ordered-coordinate tests, exact record/sample membership enumerations; duplicate and reordered lists are permitted. A root and an unvisited node both have none, so roots may be looked up repeatedly; this is included in the counts.
public_209_contract.completion_criterion: Faithful memoized extraction from actual records equals ExtractedAt, using node-count fuel, with standard-axiom verification. Count bounds are abstract operation counts, not constant-time machine operations.

claims.title: Local-array reconstruction
claims.source_claim: The paper argues local arrays with spans recover the gARG; tracing samples sees only supported edges unless an extra convention applies.
claims.existing_evidence: Existing reference and memoized actual-record reconstruction give equality with all local edges exactly iff SampleSupported. WongIntervalCanonicalization additionally supplies unique maximal finite interval records for a supplied indexed relation, semantic graph uniqueness and storage idempotence.
claims.remaining_target: Canonical interval semantics is established. A fully executable array-to-record exporter, byte-format round trip and persistent metadata packaging remain open. All-node recovery is a different observation.
claims.assumptions: Unique local parents at every coordinate; exact actual record/sample enumerations; persistent IDs and unary nodes. Equality concerns indexed edge relations, not syntactic interval partitions.
claims.completion_criterion: The indexed-relation iff criterion and canonical interval representation are checked in their named interfaces. Do not claim a byte/storage implementation round trip or erase the SampleSupported condition.

baseline_contract.remaining_target: Compose executable extraction with serialization; prove recovery exactly under SampleSupported, or unconditional recovery from all-node arrays.
baseline_contract.completion_criterion: Precise round-trip type and support criterion; source wording qualified without novelty claim.

prior_publication_contract.existing_evidence: Integrated WongSampleTracing.actual_garg_reconstruction_iff and WongRecordTracing.records_round_trip_iff prove complete indexed sample-parent arrays equal original local inheritance exactly iff SampleSupported; unsupported-edge counterexample remains.
prior_publication_contract.remaining_target: Executable extraction-to-indexed-relation recovery is closed. A finite interval serializer and canonical byte/record round trip remain E03/G06. All-node recovery is a different observation; node catalog and sample metadata must accompany arrays.
prior_publication_contract.completion_criterion: Receipt now covers executable record-scan extraction and the semantic reconstruction iff. Full finite serialization is still required for a storage-format round trip.

public_209_contract.existing_evidence: WongSampleTracing.actual_garg_reconstruction_iff, WongRecordTracing.records_round_trip_iff and WongMemoizedTracing.memoized_records_round_trip_iff prove indexed sample-parent relations equal all original local edges exactly iff SampleSupported. The memoized implementation also agrees extensionally with the reference.
public_209_contract.remaining_target: Both executable reference and memoized indexed-relation reconstruction are closed. A finite interval serializer, canonical record/byte round trip and persistent metadata packaging remain E03/G06; all-node recovery is a different observation.
public_209_contract.assumptions: Unique local parents at every coordinate; exact actual record/sample enumerations; persistent IDs and unary nodes. Equality concerns indexed edge relations, not syntactic interval partitions.
public_209_contract.completion_criterion: Receipt covers executable actual-record lookup, cached sample tracing and the semantic iff criterion. Full storage-format serialization remains outstanding.

claims.title: Executable finite interval serialization
claims.source_claim: Combine coordinate-wise child/parent incidences into edge interval sets.
claims.existing_evidence: WongIntervalCanonicalization proves executable list merging, union membership, endpoint reuse, strict separation, semantic uniqueness, canonical graph semantics and storage idempotence. Actual finite graph preparation uses classical finite enumeration and activity decisions.
claims.remaining_target: Implement and verify computable endpoint/cell enumeration, activity tests and record emission, then specify the external serialization format and parser. The existing graph adapter is noncomputable; only its list-merge component executes.
claims.assumptions: Half-open intervals, finite endpoints, deterministic ordering, persistent IDs; no silent loss of isolated nodes or samples.
claims.completion_criterion: Canonical finite interval representation is checked; full executable serialization and external byte/metadata round trips remain open.

claims.completion_criterion: Explicit problem and source attribution; no assumed solution.

claims.title: Remove vertices that never coalesce locally
claims.source_claim: Nodes unary in every local tree can be removed, increasing parent/child arities of remaining nodes.

claims.completion_criterion: Current coordinate-wise predicate facts are checked. A source-exact global never-coalescent stage with protected samples and aggregate examples remains required.

claims.title: Coordinate-dependent unary bypass
claims.source_claim: Final simplification rewrites edges at coordinates where a globally retained node is unary, while retaining it elsewhere.
claims.existing_evidence: WongSimplificationNormalForm proves that every incident retained nonsample node has two distinct children after contraction under unique local parenthood. Its canonical_resolved_normal_form composes actual MRCA truncation, sample/branching retention and canonical finite interval storage, preserving sample IDs, relevant paths and endpoint supply.
claims.remaining_target: The source-relevant deterministic normal-form theorem is established. Full pipeline idempotence, an executable implementation, intermediate global Figure 5c eligibility and literal Figure 5 replication remain separate. The final fixed-point clause is interval storage only.
claims.assumptions: Finite acyclic gARG and ordered coordinates. NoNonsampleUnary requires unique local parents. Samples are protected, including sampled ancestors; unused catalogue IDs can be isolated. MRCA path retention is conditional on a supplied IsMRCA and nonempty samples.
claims.completion_criterion: Actual finite output has the stated no-nonsample-unary property and exact contracted relation. This satisfies the scoped normal-form criterion; no unconditional all-vertices arity, executable rewrite or whole-pipeline fixed-point claim.
